policy: The Gallery admits an entry only when its provenance resolves to the original series of explorations (class original), or when it is RC4-era work the operator admitted by name. Synthetic contract fixtures, unresolved claims and originals wrapped in the invented application frame are not admitted. They stay executable as tests (gallery_cases.py --execute); they are not artwork.

workshopExamples.policy: RC4-era SDK feature recipes that the Workshop panels open (condition console, selector studio, plots, notifications, anatomy, materials, graphs, flight). They are labelled SDK examples, never in the Gallery picker or attract rotation, and are not artwork. Nullified recipes are dropped at build.
